init_EScAIPConfigs: use init_configs with EScAIPConfigs and a flat kwargs dict to build the full nested configuration object
init_GlobalConfigs: use init_configs with GlobalConfigs and a kwargs dict to create model global settings like hidden size and activation
init_MolecularGraphConfigs: use init_configs with MolecularGraphConfigs and a kwargs dict to create molecular graph parameters like KNN and radius
init_GraphNeuralNetworksConfigs: use init_configs with GraphNeuralNetworksConfigs and a kwargs dict to create GNN architecture settings like attention heads and embedding sizes
resolve_type_hint: use resolve_type_hint to convert a forward reference string type hint into its actual class object
